patch.description: Update an existing business record based on the provided details.

external_id.description: A unique identifier for this record off of Worth's platform, sometimes from other, external systems

tin.description: Taxpayer Identification Number issued by the government. Nine numeric digits with or without dash(es).

address_line_1.description: Primary street address of the business.

address_state.description: State or region of the business address.

address_postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code for the business address.

official_website.description: URL of the company's official website.

naics_code.description: North American Industry Classification System code. To find a particular code, please use https://www.naics.com/search/

naics_title.description: Title corresponding to the NAICS code.

mcc_code.description: Merchant Category Code used for classifying business activities.

is_monitoring_enabled.description: Whether ongoing monitoring is enabled for this business.

applicant_id.description: Identifier for the loan or service applicant.

send_invitation.description: Whether to send an invitation email to the applicant.

dba1_name.description: “Doing Business As” name, if different from legal name.

address1_line_1.description: Primary street address for the DBA location.

address1_apartment.description: Apartment or suite number for the DBA address.

address1_state.description: State for the DBA address (Two-letter abbreviation).

address1_postal_code.description: Postal code for the DBA address.

address1_mobile.description: Contact number for the DBA location.

annual_total_income.description: Total revenue in the last fiscal year.

total_wages.description: Total wages paid to employees last year.

annual_net_income.description: Net profit after expenses last year.

cost_of_goods_sold.description: Direct costs attributable to goods sold.

total_liabilities.description: Sum of all current and non-current liabilities.

total_assets.description: Sum of all current and non-current assets.

total_accounts_payable.description: Amount owed to suppliers and vendors.

total_short_term_investments.description: Investments easily convertible to cash within a year.

total_current_assets.description: Assets expected to be used or sold within one year.

non_current_liablities.description: Long-term obligations not due within one year.

annual_cost_of_goods_sold.description: COGS aggregated over the fiscal year.

annual_gross_profit.description: Revenue minus cost of goods sold.

annual_taxes_paid.description: Total taxes paid in the fiscal year.

annual_interest_expenses.description: Interest paid on debts during the year.

sic_code.description: Standard Industrial Classification code. Codes may be found here: https://www.osha.gov/data/sic-search

business_liens.description: Total number of liens recorded against the business.

business_liens_file_date.description: Date the most recent business lien was filed (ISO 8601 format).

business_liens_status.description: Current status of the business lien.

business_liens_status_date.description: Date when the business lien status was last updated (ISO 8601 format).

business_bankruptcies.description: Total number of bankruptcy filings for the business.

business_bankruptcies_file_date.description: Date the most recent bankruptcy case was filed (ISO 8601 format).

business_bankruptcies_chapter.description: Chapter of the bankruptcy code under which the case was filed.

business_bankruptcies_voluntary.description: Whether the bankruptcy was filed voluntarily by the business or involuntarily by creditors.

business_bankruptcies_status.description: Current status of the bankruptcy proceeding.

business_bankruptcies_status_date.description: Date when the bankruptcy status was last updated (ISO 8601 format).

business_judgements.description: Total number of court judgments recorded against the business.

business_judgements_file_date.description: Date the most recent court judgment was entered (ISO 8601 format).

business_judgements_status.description: Current status of the court judgment.

business_judgements_status_date.description: Date when the judgment status was last updated (ISO 8601 format).

business_judgements_amount.description: Monetary amount awarded in the court judgment (in dollars).

social_review_count.description: Total number of customer reviews aggregated from public sources.

social_review_score.description: Average review rating on a 1–5 scale from aggregated social reviews.

score_retrieval_date.description: Date on which credit or risk score was fetched.

owner1_title.description: Official title of the first owner.

owner1_first_name.description: First name of the first owner.

owner1_last_name.description: Last name of the first owner.

owner1_mobile.description: Mobile phone of the first owner.

owner1_ssn.description: Social Security Number of the first owner.

owner1_dob.description: Date of birth of the first owner.

owner1_address_line_1.description: Primary street address of the first owner.

owner1_address_line_2.description: Secondary address information for the first owner.

owner1_address_city.description: City for the first owner’s address.

owner1_address_state.description: State for the first owner’s address.

owner1_address_postal.description: Postal code for the first owner’s address.

owner1_address_country.description: Country for the first owner’s address.

owner1_owner_type.description: Role of the first owner (beneficiary or controlling party). Only one owner may be of type CONTROL

owner1_ownership_percentage.description: Percentage ownership held by the first owner.

bank_account_number.description: Identifier for the company’s bank account.

bank_name.description: Name of the bank where the account is held.

institution_name.description: Official institution name for banking relationships.

bank_routing_number.description: ABA routing number for the bank.

bank_official_name.description: Legal name of the bank entity.

bank_account_balance_current.description: Current recorded balance of the account.

bank_account_balance_limit.description: Overdraft or credit limit on the account.

deposit_account.description: Whether this account is used for deposits.
